# tests/fixtures

Small committed samples used by automated tests. **Do not use for evaluation** — use the full datasets in `data/` (gitignored).

| File | Rows | Source | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `darpa_sample.csv` | 1,000 | `data/darpa_subset.csv` (first 1000 rows) | Headerless: `src,dst,timestamp` |
| `darpa_sample_labels.csv` | 1,000 | `data/darpa_ground_truth_subset.csv` (first 1000 rows) | Headerless: `label` (0/1), aligned row-for-row with `darpa_sample.csv` |
| `fake_traffic.csv` | 541 | Generated by `streamguard/baseline/generate_fake_data.py` | Has header: `src,dst,timestamp,label` — synthetic burst attack for smoke tests |
